items.metric_text: residential revenue growth at REA Group
items.evidence: While Australian national residential listings in July increased 16% from the prior year, residential revenue growth at REA Group is expected to be offset by the reduction in development projects, listing declines in the commercial and Asia businesses and the recent government restrictions in Victoria.

items.metric_text: overall costs for fiscal 2021, net of the increase in sports rights costs
items.evidence: However, Foxtel expects overall costs for fiscal 2021, net of the increase in sports rights costs, to be lower than the prior year by at least $100 million (A$160 million), benefiting from various cost saving initiatives.
